questions.prompt: Adobe Firefly has two kinds of custom model. Which kind fits a brand mascot?

options.explanation: Right. Adobe says subject models focus on specific characters, products or objects, such as a brand mascot.
Adobe says style models focus on colour palettes, patterns, brush strokes and illustrative cues, not one character.

questions.prompt: In diffusers, what does a LoRA scale of 0 give you?

options.explanation: Diffusers says a value of 1 is the fully finetuned LoRA.
Right. Diffusers says a value of 0 is the same as only using the base model weights.
Diffusers describes 0 as base model only and 1 as the full LoRA.

questions.prompt: You use style reference images on Ideogram 3.0. What does Ideogram advise for the prompt?

options.text: Repeat the style in many words
options.explanation: Ideogram says to keep style words out of the prompt so the references come through.

options.text: Turn Magic Prompt on to help
options.explanation: Ideogram says to turn Magic Prompt off for a preset or style references to come through clearly.

options.text: Magic Prompt off, no style words
options.explanation: Right. Ideogram says to turn Magic Prompt off and keep style words out of the prompt. Short prompts work best.
